author: Katie Tipton
text:
Chris is a plumbing angel!!

On 5/31/22 I moved into a unit on Chester lane managed by Clemner & Co. they are slum lords!! Melinda and Mark are hostile and unprofessional people. BUT after many plumbing emergencies the owner called Chris.

The local handy man Sylvester who is a thief and untrustworthy said the toilet breaking was my fault. I’d only been in the unit 4 days. The maintenance man pulled out a bucket worth of baby wipes. Blamed me. The 2nd time the toilet overflowed with sewage from the whole complex coming up through by toilet and shower I called code enforcement. The next day Chris showed up to find a major issue!! They’ve been in the heat digging trenches to get me a functional bathroom even last Sunday which was Fathers Day. His whole crew has kids!! Chris has been sweet, respectful and very professional. When we buy a home next year I will be calling them to keep our pipes flowing!!

Thank you thank you Chris AND Drain Pro staff for making an awful situation better. I was worried because my property management sent the owner from AIC electric over to fix our breaker panel on Saturday and did a no call no show then showed up Monday without an appointment. He was mad I wasn’t home and is now harassing and doing drive buys to intimidate me. Clemner & Co. has shady contractors. Thank goodness the owner stepped in and did the right thing with Chris!!!

author: Desiree Cole
text: My husband and I called Drain pro originally to recenter our washer and dryer lines in our laundry room during a remodeling.  We set an Appointment for a couple days out to have the work done, but unfortunately we ran into another issue when our water heater started leaking. When we called again they were very understanding with my concerns and were able to come out the same day. Not only did they recenter my washer lines they ALSO relocated my water heater to the garage AND installed a brand new one!! I cant thank these guys enough, I had nothing to worry about ,while they did all the work. Drain pro is amazing, very personal, reliable and does an outstanding job!!!I highly recommend them to anyone

author: Matthewdvacations12
text: Mike is great! He didn’t charge me extra to pump my septic tank because it was Christmas Eve. Jeff the service Tech did a great job. He’s a real cool guy so if he comes out to service your septic than you’re in good hands. Would recommend hands down. Thanks again Drain Pro!

author: Gina H
text: I have been using Drain pro for 19 years. Someone convinced me to try Liberty in July 2020. I had horrible service. So reluctantly I did. Liberty left huge mounds where they dug to get to septic tanks. So now not even 6 months later we were experiencing septic back up again. I normally have to get pumped every 3-4 years so I knew something must be wrong. So I called Mike at Drain pro. Jeff came to pump my system again and asked if we had a bunch more people living with us. No we do not. Long story short Liberty did not empty my tanks. Our system is working properly. Jeff said there were no leaks going into the tanks.  I will only ever use drain pro from here on out. Mike and Jeff are honest and I know my entire system was completely drained. Jeff  put my yard back how it was no huge mounds.  Thank you drain pro.

author: Kathy M
text: Honest, Respectful, and called before arriving.  I got a bid from another company and they wanted to charge me $850 and cut my wall.  Drain Pro came out and fixed my leak without having to cut my wall for only $175.  The other company was trying to take advantage of a single women.  I appreciate Drain Pro being honest with me and I'm very, very, happy with their service!!!  I will call them again if I have any other issues with my home or rentals.
